title: Move UI strings to resources and plurals
findings_note: all UI strings hardcoded in Kotlin; TrackerAnalytics.kt:172-190 English labels
boundary: **Not in this slice:** accessibility semantics, touch-target sizes and font-scale checks (S45), and adding any translation. This slice makes translation possible; it does not translate.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
- Every user-visible string is hardcoded in Kotlin, which blocks translations (F-Droid and Weblate, Play localization) and makes streak and count wording ("1 days") wrong.
- The analytics layer builds English labels (`targetLabel`, `reminderLabel`) with a hardcoded 24-hour time and English weekday names, so those labels can never be localized.
- ViewModel messages are English strings. A ViewModel has no `Context`, so they must carry resource ids instead.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `app/src/main/res/values/strings.xml`
- All UI files under `app/src/main/java/com/squalor/consecutor/ui/` and `MainScreen.kt`
- `app/src/main/java/com/squalor/consecutor/UiEvent.kt`, `TrackerViewModel.kt`
- `app/src/main/java/com/squalor/consecutor/TrackerModels.kt`, `TrackerAnalytics.kt`
- `app/src/main/java/com/squalor/consecutor/ReminderScheduler.kt` (channel name, notification text)
- `app/build.gradle` (pseudo-locales for the debug build type)

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: - None practical for strings. The Check section's grep and pseudo-locale pass are the verification. If you change `TrackerSummary`, keep `./gradlew testDebugUnitTest` green.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Move every user-visible string into `strings.xml` with `snake_case` names grouped by screen (`dashboard_...`, `detail_...`, `settings_...`, `editor_...`, `entry_...`, `notification_...`, `event_...`, `error_...`). Use `stringResource` in Composables.
2. Use `<plurals>` and `pluralStringResource` for anything with a count: streak length ("1-day streak", "12-day streak", and a separate "week" variant), entry counts and tracker counts.
3. `UiEvent` (added in S39): change `Message(text: String)`, `Logged(text, ...)` and `Cleared(text, ...)` to carry `@StringRes val textRes: Int` and `val args: List<Any> = emptyList()` instead of text. `MainScreen` resolves them with `context.getString(textRes, *args.toTypedArray())`. The one exception is the backup import error detail, which is the English message from `BackupFormatException`. Pass it as an argument to a resource such as "Backup import failed: %1$s" and note in a code comment that the codec messages are not localized.
4. Remove `targetLabel` and `reminderLabel` from `TrackerSummary`. Carry structured data instead (`targetPeriod: TargetPeriod?`, `targetValue: Double?`, `reminder: ReminderConfig?` for an enabled reminder) and delete `formatTarget` and `formatReminder` from `TrackerAnalytics`. Build the display text in the UI from resources. Format times with `DateTimeFormatter.ofLocalizedTime(FormatStyle.SHORT)` and weekdays with `DayOfWeek.getDisplayName(TextStyle.SHORT, Locale.getDefault())`. Update any test that referred to the removed labels.
5. Localize the notification channel name and description, and the notification title and text, with resources (`context.getString`).
6. Replace the validation `when (FormError)` English text from S14 and the chart summaries from S41 with resources.
7. In `app/build.gradle` set `buildTypes { debug { pseudoLocalesEnabled true } }`. Pseudo-locales (`en-XA`, `ar-XB`) make any string that is still hardcoded stand out visually.
8. Do not translate anything. Keep `values/strings.xml` as the only strings file.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `./gradlew testDebugUnitTest lintDebug assembleDebug` passes.
- This search returns nothing for string literals passed to UI text (lint's `HardcodedText` only inspects XML, not Compose, so do not rely on it): `rg -n 'Text\("|label = \{ Text\("|contentDescription = "|title = \{ Text\("|text = "' app/src/main/java`. Fix or justify every hit.
- Run the debug build with the device language set to English (XA) pseudo-locale (Settings, System, Languages): every visible string in the dashboard, detail, editors, settings, snackbars and the reminder notification appears accented. Anything that does not is still hardcoded.
- Streaks of 1 and 2, and trackers counts of 1 and 2, read correctly.
